decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (B912A-NLPB-00600 Rev A, B912A-NLPB-00601 Rev A, B912A-NLPB-00602 Rev A, B912A-NLPB-00603, B912A-NLPB-00608, B912A-NLPB-00609, Site location plan, Design and access statement and photographs. Received: 9th April 2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Details in respect of securing the proposed internal cage to the existing ceramic glazed brick internal walls shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council as Local Planning Authority in consultation with English Heritage before the relevant work is began.
description: Erection of internal cage, erection of emergency escape hatch to the front of the building and replacement of doors at basement, lower ground floor and ground floor level
